assets.caption: Fig. C-1 Design Fatigue Curve
assets.description: Log-log plot of Total Cyclic Stress Range (KSI) on the left y-axis and Total Cyclic NOMINAL Stress (MPa) on the right y-axis versus Cycles of Load (N) on the x-axis. Shows fatigue design curves for butt-welded carbon steel in atmospheric service, with a note indicating stress concentration factors are accounted for. The curve decreases from upper-left to lower-right, becoming asymptotic at the endurance limit.
